resources.string: No data, no signup. Scan a UPI QR and UPay dials *99# with the recipient and amount already filled in — skipping the bank menus so only your PIN is left.
Your UPI PIN is never seen or stored by UrgentPay. At the moment it\'s needed, we hand off to your phone\'s secure NPCI screen — the only place a UPI PIN should ever be typed.

UrgentPay is an independent utility. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to NPCI, UPI, BHIM, or any bank. Payments are completed by your bank over the *99# / IVR telecom rails. Availability depends on your bank and SIM — no app can guarantee a transfer.
Works fully offline. We read the recipient\'s UPI ID and amount from the code — no typing.
UPay dials *99# with the answers already built in, so the bank\'s menu steps are gone — and so is the waiting between them.
Your bank asks for the PIN on its own secure screen. UPay never sees it. No internet used at any step.
For the final approval, your bank\'s secure UPI PIN screen opens. UrgentPay never handles your PIN.
Always verify the recipient before approving. Sending money cannot be undone.
Everything is filled in — only your UPI PIN is left.
Menus skipped. Paste the UPI ID when asked, then your PIN.
The menus are skipped — answer what\'s left.
Your UPI PIN is typed on your phone\'s own *99# screen, never in UPay. The app only dials — it cannot see your PIN.

Your bank will ask “Enter UPI ID”. Long-press that box and tap Paste.\n\nUPay can\'t type it for you: Android strips the “@” out of anything it dials, so a UPI ID sent that way arrives at the bank broken.
These follow NPCI’s standard *99# menu, which is the same at every bank — the defaults should just work. They are here only in case an issuer or language pack ever reorders them.
Enter UPI PIN in secure dialer
This device can\'t run *99# inside the app. Opening the secure dialer with *99# instead.
The mobile network ended the session. You can retry from the secure dialer.
Enter a valid UPI ID or 10-digit mobile number.
Phone permission is needed to run the offline payment rail. You can also use the secure dialer.

Add someone you\'ve saved at your bank and UPay can pay them in one shot — no menus, no pasting, just your PIN.\n\nThis is the only way a UPI ID can be sent complete, because the bank refers to a saved payee by a number.

First save this person at your bank (during any *99# payment, choose to save the payee when offered). Your bank then lists them under a number.\n\nEnter that number here and UPay can pay them in a single dial — nothing left but your PIN.
Their number in the bank\'s list
Fill in a name, a UPI ID, and the bank\'s list number.
Remove %1$s from your one-tap payees? This only forgets them in UPay — your bank keeps them saved.
One tap — everything is filled in but your PIN.

This UPI ID is a mobile number, so UPay can send the whole payment in one go — nothing to paste.\n\nPaying %1$s instead of %2$s. It reaches the same person, but lands in whichever account they have set as their UPI default, which may not be this one.
